description: bravebot: a Rust workspace (cargo) with a thin npm wrapper, checked by ci.yml plus the organization-level brave/security-action scan.
research: Read {targetRepo}/agents/AGENTS.md — the prompt-injection rule it states overrides every other consideration in this repo
Read {targetRepo}/docs/development.md for the build, check, and security-scan commands
validations: Build the project: cargo build --all --locked (must pass)
Format the code: cargo fmt --all (must pass)
Run make check (cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -D warnings, cargo test --all --locked, toolchain age) and fix every failure (must pass)
Run make check-spec — the mechanical docs/specs check: clause numbering, the tests each clause names, the paths it governs (must pass)
Run make check-npm — npm ci --ignore-scripts and the lockfile lint, as the npm-lockfile CI job does (must pass)
Run make check-reviewdog — the brave/security-action scan that comments on the PR, over this branch's changes; fix every finding it reports (must pass)
Run make check-msrv — cargo build --all --locked in a container pinned to the declared minimum Rust, as the minimum-toolchain CI job does (must pass; needs Docker)
Run make check-linux — fmt, clippy -D warnings and tests on Linux under current stable, which a macOS host never covers (must pass; needs Docker)
Run cargo fmt --all one final time; if it makes any changes, amend the last commit with the formatting fixes

testSteps.testFix: Run the failing test: cargo test --all {testFilter} (must pass — run it 3 times to confirm it is not flaky)
testSteps.disabledTest: Run the re-enabled test: cargo test --all {testFilter} (must pass — run it 3 times to confirm it is not flaky)
testSteps.generic: Add or update the tests that cover the change, then run cargo test --all --locked (must pass)
